findings.note: A Canucks game preview published Oct 15, 2026 says Reinhart centers Florida's top line with both Tkachuks on his wings and leads the 3-2-2 Panthers with four goals. It doesn't give his assist total. No injury news was found for him.

In the Oct 4 projected lineup, Reinhart was a wing next to center Lars Eller and Brady Tkachuk, which means his role has changed this month. Lines may still be shifting, and I couldn't find a projected lineup for tonight.
A foot injury cost Reinhart the last 17 games of 2025-26; a June 2026 report said he should be fine for camp. He had 32 assists in 64 games last season, with 25 of his points on the power play.
